ideas.what: Bi-complement 𝔏** of a stratified subset of a subdivided line: remove redundant (order-2) vertices and concatenate the adjacent intervals
ideas.modern_name: Regularisation / interior-of-closure of a constructible subset of a 1-dimensional stratified space; coarsening of a cell decomposition by removing degree-2 vertices

ideas.what: Shadow Omb°_M(𝔏) as the down-closure of a set of strata under the specialisation order ≪
ideas.modern_name: Closure in the Alexandrov topology of a stratification poset (order ideal generated by 𝔏)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Alexandrov (finite/poset topologies); standard in stratified spaces
ideas.where_published: Possibly related to the tame topology discussion in Esquisse d'un programme (1984), but not this specific formalism

ideas.what: Correspondence between merged intervals and convex components of 𝔏 (chains possibly enlarged by end vertices)
ideas.modern_name: Connected components of a subset of a subdivided ordered set

deep.surprise_reason: Elementary combinatorics of strata on a subdivided totally ordered set (complement, double complement, shadows). It is a preparatory lemma for a key result on the next page, with no apparent new or uncredited mathematics on this page itself.
